body:
Doesn't `<Chat>` already have the `ais-Chat` class name?

```suggestion
      <Chat {...widgetParams} />
```
Would you be able to rely on an exported type based off of ChatWidgetSetup (before being scoped to `T`), instead of repeating the structure?
the type is actually different, this is the type per flavour, but the exported one is the union of all parameters.
This is fixed on the follow-up PR adding more tests, but also makes sense to fix here if needed.
